body.purpose: Editor content, form fields, primary reading text.

label.purpose: Default size for list-item text, row labels, tab labels — the 12px floor for anything selectable.

micro-label.purpose: Section headers only (PLANS, NODES, ARCHIVED) — uppercase + tracking buys back legibility at 11px; never body content.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Dropdown menus and popovers detaching from the page.

motion.name: hover-fast
motion.purpose: Row/button hover fills and resize-handle color — precise and immediate, no bounce.

components.name: List Row
components.description: A file-tree row or Planning sidebar row — default state.
components.css: .ds-list-row { display: flex; align-items: center; width: 100%; padding: 6px 8px; background: transparent; font-family: 'Sometype Mono', monospace; transition: background 80ms ease-out; } .ds-list-row:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); } .ds-list-row-label { font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: #9a9a9a; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }

components.name: List Row (Active)
components.description: A file-tree row or sidebar row in its selected/active state.
components.css: .ds-list-row-active { display: flex; align-items: center; width: 100%; padding: 6px 8px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); font-family: 'Sometype Mono', monospace; } .ds-list-row-active-label { font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: #e8e8e8; }

components.name: Hover Icon Button
components.description: A row-hover action (Play, Add-to-Plan, new file/folder, archive) — icon stays small, click box stays comfortable.
components.html: <button class="ds-hover-icon-btn" title="Add to plan" aria-label="Add to plan"><svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-hover-icon-btn { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; background: transparent; border: none; border-radius: 2px; color: #e8e8e8; cursor: pointer; transition: background 80ms ease-out; } .ds-hover-icon-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); } .ds-hover-icon-btn:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #dce8f0; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Tab
components.description: A WorkspaceHeader tab strip item — default and active states.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; align-items: center; font-family: 'Sometype Mono', monospace; } .ds-tab { padding: 8px 12px; background: transparent; border: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: #4a4a4a; cursor: pointer; transition: background 80ms ease-out, color 80ms ease-out; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #9a9a9a; } .ds-tab-active { color: #e8e8e8; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border-bottom-color: #e8e8e8; }

components.name: Section Header
components.description: A sidebar section label (PLANS, NODES, ARCHIVED, or a folder root path).
components.css: .ds-section-header { font-family: 'Sometype Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #9a9a9a; }

narrative.overview: Sleipnir reads like a heads-up display for building UI, not a consumer app. Near-monochrome white-on-black, sharp near-zero corners, translucent layered panels stacked by opacity rather than lifted by shadow, one mono typeface throughout. It's built for people who live in it for hours — scanning file trees, editing components, watching an AI agent plan and generate code, reviewing a Git diff — moving fast between many small, information-dense panels rather than reading long-form content. This system explicitly rejects consumer-SaaS softness: no pastel palette, no rounded cards-on-cards, no cheerful copy, no drop-shadow-heavy elevation, nothing skeuomorphic or glassy. But density is not an excuse for illegibility — the HUD is precise, not cramped. Text stays comfortably readable and every clickable icon keeps a real, comfortable hit target, even inside the densest sidebar list.
keyCharacteristics: Near-monochrome dark surface; color reserved for status meaning, never decoration
One mono family (Sometype Mono) carries body, label, and code text alike
Depth from translucent layering + hairline borders, not drop shadows
Every interactive row/button gets a real hover state and a real click target

rules.name: The Brightness-Not-Hue Rule
rules.body: Emphasis comes from how bright something is, not from introducing a new color.

rules.name: The 12px Floor Rule
rules.body: Interactive/selectable list text never goes below Label size (12px). Micro-label (11px, uppercase, tracked) is for section headers only.

rules.name: The Layering-Not-Lifting Rule
rules.body: A panel becomes closer by getting brighter/more opaque, not by casting a shadow.

rules.name: The Two-Number Button Rule
rules.body: Every hover icon button has an icon size and a hit-target size, and they are never the same number.

dos: Do keep interactive list/row text at 12px (Label) minimum
Do give every hover-revealed icon button a real ~28x28px click box
Do use brightness/opacity steps for hierarchy before reaching for a new color
Do reserve uppercase + heavy tracking for true section headers
Do keep borders to the two defined weights (hairline / emphasis)
donts: Don't hardcode raw fontSize 9/10/11 inline pixel values for selectable or continuously-read text
Don't size a hover button's clickable area to match its icon's visual size
Don't introduce drop-shadow elevation on docked/inline panels
Don't use rounded/soft radii, pastel colors, or gradient fills
Don't add a third border weight or a new gray outside the text-1/2/3 ramp for one component
